flags.text: Hell of a jungle game: Khaimera's 14 kills and 49779 objective damage led all ten players.
Duo lane: four enemy duo deaths before minute ten, zero allied; Skylar killed Riktor six times.
Lt. Belica killed Riktor, Rampage and Howitzer in the final fight, won 4-1, then the enemy Core fell.

focus.title: Regroup after every objective take

18.5.call: Won 4-1 across the duo lane and enemy jungle; Lt. Belica's kill on Rampage came after the Skylar death, and Fangtooth followed.

20.1.call: Separate plays on three lanes went 5-1; Lt. Belica took the enemy offlane outer inside the window, and the enemy duo inner fell next.

matchup: Howitzer, the lane opponent, dealt 38607 hero damage, the game's most, and scored three of four Iggy & Scorch deaths.
Howitzer's Tainted Rounds briefly cuts healing on each basic attack hit, shrinking the Art Of Fortitude restore during trades.
build: Orb Of Enlightenment, the evolved Orb Of Growth, and Megacosm are two of three winning-core items; Entropy is missing.
Dreambinder slows targets hit by ability damage, less for damage-over-time abilities; Caustica, the last item, missed the earlier fights.
Megacosm adds max-health damage over time on ability damage, plus bonus-health damage against heroes.
eternal: Aion grants mana regeneration per cast and gold from spell damage on heroes; Philosopher adds gold over time.
Aion leans ahead in the Iggy & Scorch offlane field; Sacrifice with Runic Focus is the best Aion pair.
augment: Hold This! permanently adds Molotov explosion damage against heroes each time the explosion hits a hero.
Turret Maniac and Hold This! are a field toss-up; Hold This! is a sound keep.
crest: Epoch's active enters Stasis briefly; Epoch leans ahead of Soulbearer in the Iggy & Scorch offlane field. Sound keep.
improvement: Sacrifice with Runic Focus over Philosopher with Arcane Resonance matches the best Aion pair: mana on hero hits over passive gold.
If the lane holds, Entropy for Dreambinder completes the winning core, trading the ability slow for extra ability damage.

matchup: The Fey built Tainted Scepter and Wraith Leggings: a healing cut on magical damage and bonus ability damage on low-health heroes.
Rampage's Boulder Throw stuns and Pounce launches heroes, the jungle threat on the mid lane.
Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage and Void Drone's mana drain both work against The Fey's mana pool.
build: Combustion, Noxia and Wraith Leggings are the full winning core; Oblivion Crown, the last item, raises magical power by a quarter.
Noxia marks heroes hit by ability damage; a separate ability on the marked hero adds max-health damage.
eternal: Aion gives mana regeneration per cast and gold from spell damage; Bottomless Vial adds magical power per River Buff kill.
Bottomless Vial with Runic Focus is the best Aion pair, but Lotus leads the Lt. Belica mid field and Aion ranks third.
augment: Combat Veteran adds movement speed and passive experience each second; the field's Best Lt. Belica mid augment. Sound keep.
crest: Soulbearer's active grants a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed; Typhoon leans ahead of Epoch, with Soulbearer behind both.
Typhoon starts from Warlock Crest and Soulbearer from Wizard Crest, so the swap starts at the first crest buy.
improvement: Lotus for Aion is the field-backed Eternal lean, giving up spell-damage gold; Early Bloom with Immaculate is the best Lotus pair.
Typhoon for Soulbearer is the crest lean: attack-speed stacks and a dash, giving up the shield and lifesteal.

matchup: Duo was Skylar and Argus against TwinBlast and Riktor; TwinBlast scored two of seven Skylar deaths.
Riktor's Skewer suppresses and Shock Therapy silences; Riktor's Tainted Guard cuts healing for heroes basic-attacking Riktor.
TwinBlast's Tainted Rounds cuts the target's healing on basic attacks, trimming the omnivamp healing from Eviscerator's active.
build: Plasma Blade, Imperator and Vanquisher are the full winning core.
Vanquisher executes heroes at very low health; Imperator boosts critical strike damage, fed by Plasma Blade's stacking crit chance.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage projectiles on hitting a low-health hero; Forage adds gold and experience per minion or monster kill.
Forage with Wind-Rider is the best Weald pair; Xyris leans ahead of Weald in the Skylar carry field.
augment: Assault MK-II extends the Air Assault hover and adds a missile per attack; the field leans to Assault MK-II. Sound keep.
crest: Eviscerator's active adds attack speed, omnivamp and on-hit damage; Eviscerator leans ahead of Pacifier in the field. Sound keep.
improvement: Xyris for Weald is the field-backed Eternal lean: bonus damage growing with units killed, a fit once the farm gap closes.
No item change proven; the winning core is complete.

matchup: Rampage, the jungle opponent, traded kills with Khaimera three for three.
All five enemies built a healing cut: Tainted Rounds on three, Tainted Scepter on The Fey, Tainted Guard on Riktor.
Khaimera took 59501 damage, the game's most.
build: Sky Splitter and Ashbringer are two of three winning-core items; Onixian Quiver is missing, Void Helm and Claw Of Hermes off-meta.
Void Helm adds magical armor and 20% more healing from all sources, offsetting part of the enemy healing cuts.
No physical armor item against a three-physical enemy comp, the flag the matchup check raised.
eternal: Lotus grants a random stat every two minutes and on each takedown; Masterpiece adds damage and movement speed on kills.
Lotus leans ahead of Satariel in the Khaimera jungle field; Masterpiece with Immaculate is the best Lotus pair. Sound keep.
augment: Jungle Invasion adds physical power in the jungle, doubled in the enemy jungle; toss-up lead with Lane Lurker. Sound keep.
crest: Eviscerator is the field's Best Khaimera jungle crest; the active adds attack speed, omnivamp and on-hit damage. Sound keep.
improvement: Against a three-physical enemy comp again, a physical armor item over Claw Of Hermes answers the flag, giving up mana burn.
Onixian Quiver completes the winning core; on melee heroes Onixia adds critical chance and mitigation at low health.

matchup: Duo was Argus and Skylar against Riktor and TwinBlast; Argus killed Riktor once and TwinBlast once.
Synaptic Obliterator grants immunity to pushes and pulls while active, so Riplash cannot drag Argus mid-channel; Skewer still suppresses.
TwinBlast scored the only Argus death, in the enemy jungle.
build: Timewarp, Dynamo and Tainted Scepter are the full winning core; Entropy is the off-meta fourth.
Dynamo makes immobilized enemies take more damage briefly; the Dread Nova stun is the trigger.
eternal: Flawless heals Argus and nearby allies on ability hits against enemy heroes; Fragrance adds magical damage to close enemy heroes.
Vesh and Lotus are a field toss-up for Argus support; Flawless with Fragrance is the best Lotus pair. Sound keep.
augment: Infinite Obliteration gives Synaptic Obliterator infinite range, faster projectiles and longer slows; toss-up with Arcane Engine. Sound keep.
crest: Leafsong's active speeds nearby allies, grants slow immunity and lets allies pass through heroes; Leafsong leans ahead of Tranquility. Sound keep.
improvement: No change proven: one death, and every pick holds the field lead or a toss-up share.

threats: Chain-CC risk (4 hard-CC abilities, ~3.0s of lockdown): Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s), Howitzer Land Mine (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.
